
# LAB:Unprotected admin functionality with unpredictable URL
![Server-Side-Vulnerabilities/LAB- Unprotected admin functionality with unpredictable URL 20260812-143733.png](data:image/png;base64,)

To Solve this Lab  we had to inspect the *html* code base from the dev tools or burp for this demo I will be using the developer tools available in almost every browser I've ever used.

After accessing the LAB we get the *We Like To Shop* landing page
![Server-Side-Vulnerabilities/LAB- Unprotected admin functionality with unpredictable URL 20260812-144601.png](data:image/png;base64,)

Open the dev tools by right clicking on you mouspad and select inspect:

On Fire Fox browser tap on the inspector as shown below and type 'Admin panel' from  the search pad presented then press Enter:

![Server-Side-Vulnerabilities/LAB- Unprotected admin functionality with unpredictable URL 20260812-144837.png](data:image/png;base64,)

From the screenshot below after searching *Admin Panel* we realise two key points and the solution to solving this lab:
-  The reason the search revealed the unpredictable URL
-  How we found the upredictable URL

![Server-Side-Vulnerabilities/LAB- Unprotected admin functionality with unpredictable URL 20260812-145159.png](data:image/png;base64,)

As clearly indicated the unpredictable URL is assigned the value 'Admin Panel' which made it possible to search for it and get the URL immidiately

By appending the link to the url parameter we get the Admin panel where we can *delete the user Carlos*

![Server-Side-Vulnerabilities/LAB- Unprotected admin functionality with unpredictable URL 20260812-150235.png](data:image/png;base64,)

### Take aways:
This lab demonstrates that making administrative URL difficult to access does not constitute access control.

### Key notes~

To prevernt such a vulenrability the developer/server should implement:

- User Authentication
- Verification of users permisions/role on the server side
- Deny authorization requests with 401 Unauthorized or 403 frobidden
- Apply authorization checks to every privileged endpoint/action
- Do not rely on an unpredictable,secret or hard -to-guess URL as an authorization mechanism
- Ensure the privileged Functionality remains protected even if it URL become known
